title: Recording: Let ’Em In by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

Wings continued work on the Wings At The Speed Of Sound song ‘Let ’Em In’ on 12 February 1976.

This was a vocal overdub session. Paul McCartney recorded his lead vocals, and he, Linda McCartney, and Denny Laine added harmony vocals.
